sparks.why: Makers ART Market listing (ma.to) for the Beverly Connection, 100 N. La Cienega Blvd: Sundays 12 to 6 pm through 13 Dec 2026. Filed as flea as the closest kind for a vendor market; the Sunday date itself has no dedicated page.
